purpose: Leo visual feedback: jump head appears larger
method: deterministic outer light crown contour in upper 45% of each normalized 240x320 frame; diagnostic only, no artwork mutation

interpretation.absoluteCrownWidthCaveat: jump/walk crown pixels are wider than the idle crown, but this contour changes with pose and visibility and cannot alone prove head/body scale drift
interpretation.rigidProbe: the accepted 12-frame calibration set reads 87px on the dark head probe with 0% variation; seq278 walk+jump use one fixed coefficient
interpretation.visualInterpretation: jump bodies are naturally shorter because of crouch/takeoff pose, so the same absolute head reads as a larger fraction of the full character
interpretation.r1Status: mechanical head-scale drift not proven; Leo visual concern remains an aesthetic gate. If rejected, return to source generation/selection rather than per-frame resize or head editing
